newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-EMERSON "VERY HAPPY" AT MIDDLESBROUGH, SAYS AGENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EMERSON "VERY HAPPY" AT MIDDLESBROUGH, SAYS AGENT.

text.p: Brazilian Emerson is "very happy "at English premier league club Middlesbrough, his British agent Gianni Paladini said on Wednesday.
He insisted Emerson would be back in Middlesbrough from his holiday in Brazil in time for training on Thursday.
Emerson, a four million pound ($6.6 million) summer signing from Portuguese club Porto, has been reported to have said he was unhappy in the English northeast and never wanted to return to the club.
But Paladini told SKY television: "Emerson is very happy with Middlesbrough . He has no problem whatsover with the football club or the players.
"Emerson had permission to go to Brazil. Then he was supposed to come back but obviously he had a little problem which the club know all about."
Paladini played down reports of Emerson's wife being homsick, saying she would definitely return to England after experiencing "normal difficulties" in adjusting to life in a new country.
Earlier, Middlesbrough owner Steve Gibson said he wanted to know where Emerson stood with the club.
"I want a full explanation when he gets back," Gibson said. "He signed a four-year contract. We offered him certain terms which he accepted and every one of those terms has been met."
Middlesbrough were reassured to learn that the other Brazilian midfielder on their books, Juninho, has no plans to leave the club.
"I don't know where these stories have come from about me leaving the club," he said. "I am happy at Middlesbrough and I am pleased with the way things are going."
Emerson has not given any interviews in his native Brazil since he returned and it is not known where he has been staying.
Local media say the player is most likely to be in Rio de Janeiro or the southern city of Curitiba, where he began his career with a local club.
